title: A lower bound for the ratio of the polynomials R_d and P_d
statement:
Let $R_d(x)$ and $P_d(x)$ be the polynomials whose ratio is under consideration. **Lower-bound conjecture.** If $d\ge5$ and $x\ge\frac12(d+\sqrt{d+2})$, then

$$
-\frac{R_d(x)}{P_d(x)}\ge\frac{.995(d-2)}{2x+d-2}.
$$

This conjecture is presented as information needed to make the paper's expression for the focal function $g(s_1,s_2)$ useful; the source provides no resolution evidence.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0910.5725

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2009).
source_name: Donald M. Davis, “Maximizing a combinatorial expression arising from crowd estimation”, arXiv:0910.5725 (2009).
